title: Sphynx exam
description: A timed, graded set of challenges. Lives in <exams folder>/<exam-id>/exam.json; question folders can sit next to it. Guide: docs/exams.md

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the folder name (recommended: leave it out).

title.description: Name shown in the Exams group and in the results file.

description.description: Short text shown in the tooltip, e.g. what the exam covers.

translations.description: Translations of the title and description, by language (for example "pt-br").

durationMinutes.description: Time limit. When it runs out, answers are submitted automatically and the exam is locked.

enumDescriptions: Closed book: hints and AI hints are off; large pastes/AI completions, time outside VS Code and an enabled GitHub Copilot are recorded as warnings in the results.
Open book: hints, AI hints and the internet are allowed.

maxSubmissions.description: Submissions allowed per question. The best one counts. Run (sample tests) is unlimited.

subject.description: The subject whose sidebar lists the exam, e.g. "java" or "cs" (a subject id from subjects/<id>/subject.json). By default, the subject most of the questions come from.

restrictions.description: How strict the exam is: pick a level, and optionally override single rules next to it. Closed exams default to "standard", open exams to "none". Guide: docs/exams.md#restrictions

enumDescriptions: No restrictions and nothing recorded (default for open exams).
Nothing blocked; large pastes, time outside VS Code and Copilot are recorded in the results.
Records everything, blocks copying and pastes of 50+ characters (default for closed exams).
Like standard, blocks pastes of 30+ characters, and finishes the exam after 60 s outside VS Code in total.

record.description: Record integrity warnings (pastes, time away, Copilot). Always on when something is blocked or limited.

blockCopy.description: No copying from the question panel, and no Copy/Cut in the answer files. Default: from the level.

blockPaste.description: Pastes of pasteLimit characters or more are undone and recorded. Default: from the level.

pasteLimit.description: Smallest paste that is blocked, in characters. Typing, autocomplete and snippets stay below it.

maxAwaySeconds.description: Total seconds a student may spend outside VS Code; past it the exam finishes automatically. 0 = no limit (time away is only recorded).

id.description: A challenge or quiz folder inside this exam folder, or the id of any loaded challenge or quiz (e.g. "even-or-odd", "java-basics-quiz"). Quizzes are submitted once.

points.description: Points for this question. Partial credit = points × tests passed / total tests (for a quiz: points × quiz points earned / quiz total).
